design.name: 獓狠
design.brief: The Aoyin (獓狠) of Sanwei Mountain in the Shan Hai Jing, 'shaped like an ox, white body, four horns, its hair like a straw raincoat, it eats people': a colossal white yak-like ox about 2.6 m at the shoulder and 4.2 m long, with a massive humped back, a low heavy head and FOUR long curved horns (two sweeping forward, two curling back). The whole body is draped in very long shaggy cream-white hair hanging almost to the ground in thick layered tiers like a straw rain cape (蓑衣), sculpted as big carved overlapping hair panels; magenta-violet lightning veins glow in the gaps between the tiers. Nested between the four horn bases sits a glowing magenta-violet thunder orb (weak spot), attached to the skull. Small fierce violet eyes, a weathered copper nose ring, heavy black hooves. Huge, slow and terrifying. NOT a two-horned bull.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a big yak (quadruped), the body level, the four thick legs straight under the body and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air between them; the long shaggy fur hangs like a straw raincoat but ends ABOVE the knees, so all four lower legs and hooves are clearly visible and separate; the head level facing straight ahead with the mouth closed; the four horns (two big curved outer horns and two smaller inner horns) with EMPTY space between them: NO orb, NO sphere and NO lightning between the horns (the thunder orb is a separate effect); the tail hanging straight down; the lightning veins in the fur painted opaque (no halo)
design.turnaround_digits: each foot a split cloven hoof with two separate toes; all four horns and the tail fully inside the frame.
